    values = []

            continue
        for row_idx, row in table_rows(node):
            label = list(row.values())[0].strip()
            if desc_to_id(label) == label_desc:
                for col, cell in row.items():
                    if col == node["table"]["columns"][0]:
                        continue
                    year = parse_year(col)
                    val = parse_number(cell)
                    if year is not None and val is not None:
                        values.append((year, val))
    # Sort by year and compute differences

    diffs = [y2-y1 for (y1, v1), (y2, v2) in zip(values[:-1], values[1:])]
    if diffs:
        print(f"Avg yearly change for {label_desc} (in absolute units): {sum(diffs)/len(diffs):.2f}")

        print(f"No yearly data for {label_desc}")
